title: Africa coverage evidence tranche 2A - Eswatini, Lesotho, Liberia, Zambia, Uganda

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The Government of Eswatini Ministry of Home Affairs page identifies its Immigration Department and describes responsibility for entry and residence permission, visas, permits, border control, citizenship, and travel documents.

Lesotho's Ministry of Home Affairs identifies the Department of Immigration Services as responsible for migration, border control, visas, residence permits, citizenship, refugee asylum, and related immigration legislation.

The Liberia Immigration Service official portal identifies the service as a Ministry of Justice security agency mandated to enforce Liberia's Alien and Nationality Law and manage borders, entry, residence, citizenship, and related immigration services.
The Zambia Department of Immigration official guide identifies the department and describes its role in regulating entry, exit, and immigrant stays through visa and immigration-permit services.
Uganda's Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control official portal describes visas and passes under national immigration law and provides the government's immigration service catalogue.

batch.name: v10.22.21 Africa evidence tranche 2A - SZ, LS, LR, ZM, UG
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Eswatini (SZ), Lesotho (LS), Liberia (LR), Zambia (ZM), and Uganda (UG). All five endpoints were probed on 2026-07-18 through the controlled API-container retriever and returned HTTPS 200 with usable generic-parser content. Algeria (DZ) and The Gambia (GM) were excluded after transport failures, and Nigeria (NG) was excluded after HTTP 403; retrieval controls were not weakened. The tranche is limited to the narrow service functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Government of Eswatini Ministry of Home Affairs Immigration page
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Government of Eswatini Ministry of Home Affairs page identifies its Immigration Department as responsible for orderly immigration, permission to enter or reside, visas, residence permits, border management, citizenship, and travel documents. This supports a proposal that Eswatini directly administers the relevant immigration services through the Ministry of Home Affairs Immigration Department.

immigration_assessment.rationale: The Liberia Immigration Service official portal identifies the service as a Ministry of Justice security agency mandated to implement and enforce the Alien and Nationality Law, protect and manage borders, admit foreign nationals, and provide residence and citizenship services. This supports a proposal that Liberia directly administers the relevant immigration services through the Liberia Immigration Service.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Zambia Department of Immigration guide to immigration permits and visas
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Zambia Department of Immigration official guide identifies the department and states that it facilitates and regulates entry and exit and controls the stay of immigrants and visitors through visa and permit services. This supports a proposal that Zambia directly administers the relevant immigration services through the Department of Immigration.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Uganda Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control Visas and Passes page
immigration_assessment.rationale: Uganda's Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control official portal states that entry must comply with national immigration law and provides government visa and pass services. This supports a proposal that Uganda directly administers the relevant immigration services through the Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control.
